intro: Ephesians describes the church as God's family, made one in Christ.
Chapters one to three tell what God has done: chosen us, saved us by grace, and broken down the wall between peoples.
Chapters four to six show how to live: walking in love, at home and at work, and standing strong in the armour of God.
Listen for chapter two: by grace are ye saved through faith.

card.parts: Ch. 1–3: what God has done | Ch. 4–6: how to live
card.key: Saved by grace (2) · One body (4) · The armour of God (6)
